description: Alerts from the liquidity sentinel, which reads every pool about every 1.5 seconds: pools whose base liquidity (BNB, USDT...) dropped 40% (liquidity_falling) or 70% or more (liquidity_collapsed) from their peak. Covers every pool found in the last 24 hours on PancakeSwap, Uniswap V4 and PancakeSwap Infinity. The free plan sees alerts with a 60-second delay.
name: get_liquidity_alerts
title: Liquidity alerts
